angular.notes: Native Angular: MnAlert. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

taro.notes: Semantic roles/colors/variants/sizes, title/actions/custom icons, alert collapse/close/animations/banner/rounding/elevation and guarded tag actions/loading/shape/elevation and native measured touch-origin ripples. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Tag ripple coordinates use native touch/tap data and measured bounds, falling back to center for keyboard activation or hosts without coordinates. DOM focus-return behavior is not reproduced. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Semantic colors/variants/sizes, status icons and custom icon/action/close slots, dismiss, controlled/default expansion, banner/elevation/radius and animation. ReactNode icon/action values use native slots; no DOM transition event objects. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Colors/variants/sizes, semantic status, icon/title/action/close slots, banner/elevation/radius, animations, controlled/uncontrolled collapse with labels and return focus. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

angular.notes: Native Angular: MnAnswerSheet. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

native.notes: Pressable pills in wrapping rows (layout=scroll: a horizontal ScrollView that centres the current pill with scrollTo after layout); no arrow-key roving focus on native

taro.notes: Numbered question pills grouped by section with unanswered/answered/correct/wrong/skipped statuses, flag dot, controlled/uncontrolled current question (aria-current=step), wrap/scroll layouts, fixed columns, translated item labels, summary and legend, and two sizes. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports arrow keys and Home/End across the pills (disabled pills are skipped; no row-wise ArrowUp/ArrowDown); native hosts use tap selection. layout=scroll centres the current pill through the ScrollView scrollLeft, measured with createSelectorQuery after each change. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Shared core sections and counts: numbered question pills grouped by section (untitled section first), unanswered/answered/correct/wrong/skipped statuses, flag dot, controlled/default current question with aria-current=step, wrap/scroll layouts, fixed columns, localized item labels with getItemLabel through configure(), summary, legend, size, disabled and readOnly. Items and groups are plain serializable arrays; selection is by tap. DOM roving keyboard focus is not a native mini-program interaction. layout=scroll centres the current pill through the scroll-view scroll-left, measured with createSelectorQuery after each change (RTL is not mirrored). Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Shared core sections and counts: numbered question pills grouped by section (untitled section first), unanswered/answered/correct/wrong/skipped statuses, flag dot, controlled/default current question (v-model) with aria-current=step, wrap/scroll layouts, fixed columns, localized item labels, getItemLabel, summary, legend, size and disabled; arrow, Home/End and Enter/Space keys (ArrowUp/ArrowDown by row with columns). Keyboard metadata and native tap selection are implemented; without columns ArrowUp/ArrowDown do not move (no layout measurement), and device focus/geometry still require validation. layout=scroll centres the current pill through the scroll-view scroll-left (measured with createSelectorQuery on native hosts). Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

taro.notes: Native view layouts, token-aware Box background/radius/shadow and numeric size resolution, spacing and attached controls, container-measured responsive grids/SplitLayout, sections/actions, compact/expanded/floating AppShell navigation and mobile drawer with route-change dismissal. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. CSS as/asChild polymorphism is not native. Floating AppShell expands by touch rather than hover. Measurements initially use window width until the native selector query returns. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Controlled/default expanded/compact/floating modes, mobile drawer/backdrop, navigationKey close, explicit pin/expand controls, brand/header/page navigation/footer slots and navigationstate events. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

angular.notes: Native Angular: MnAreaChart. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

native.notes: Chart component of minerva-design/native: the canvas chart engine drawn with views (touch scrub, pinch zoom, legend toggles).

taro.notes: Cartesian charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free engine (minerva-design/charts presets): the web component props mapped to the same engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset, H5 mouse hover; ref exposes resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize. No WebGPU / WebGL renderer (one Canvas 2D path), no keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. QuadrantChart accessible points: a visually hidden list of the points (role / aria-role, aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap is onPointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons calling onPointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant. Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Chart whose untyped series are areas: smooth by default (`curve`), `stacked` or 100% (`percent`). Same as Chart. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

No WebGPU / WebGL renderer and no keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. angular.notes: Native Angular: MnAutoComplete. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

taro.notes: Filter/sort/group options including numeric values, loading/empty states, native confirm first-enabled selection, input props, label fill and original selection/click callbacks; four measured placements and offsets with viewport collision fitting. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports arrow-key active-option navigation and Enter commit with input focus retained. Native confirm chooses the first enabled filtered option when autoHighlight is enabled. The popup remains inline. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Controlled editable text, numeric/string option identity, label fill, disabled/loading guards, custom filtering/sorting/grouping via native instance configure(), native confirm selection, original option events. Function callbacks use selectComponent(...).configure({filterOption,groupBy,sortOption}) because WXML properties are serialized; option content supports label/description and empty slot instead of React render functions. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Controlled/model/default text and owner rejection; numeric option identities; selection returns the option and fills its label; fillOnSelect, filter/sort, first/adjacent groups, loading/empty/option slots, autoHighlight, native confirm, H5 keys, IME guards and dropdown visibility events. Reuses Input for field props. Custom content uses native scoped slots instead of React renderOption/renderEmpty functions. Measured native fixed dropdown flips/shifts within the viewport and can animate; it does not use a DOM portal. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

taro.notes: Retryable image failure fallback, CJK/word initials, React avatar sizes/shapes, group overlap/additional overflow counts, standalone or attached badges, four corners, border geometry and semantic variants. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Native image decoding and device text metrics require device validation. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Content, count/dot, cap/zero visibility, semantic colors, solid/subtle/outline, sizes, corner position, border and icon slot. Attached content is the default slot; ReactNode content uses native text/icon slots. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Inline text or attached badge; content/icon slots; size, semantic color, variant, position, radius/border and decorative dot/count extensions. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

native.notes: Chart component of minerva-design/native: the canvas chart engine drawn with views (touch scrub, pinch zoom, legend toggles).

taro.notes: Cartesian charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free engine (minerva-design/charts presets): the web component props mapped to the same engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset, H5 mouse hover; ref exposes resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize. No WebGPU / WebGL renderer (one Canvas 2D path), no keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. QuadrantChart accessible points: a visually hidden list of the points (role / aria-role, aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap is onPointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons calling onPointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant. Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Chart whose untyped series are bars, grouped or `stacked`. Same as Chart. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Cartesian chart drawn on a `<canvas type="2d">` by the DOM-free engine: the web component props mapped to the same presets and engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset; hover/pointClick/plotClick/zoom events and a template ref handle (resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize). No WebGPU / WebGL renderer and no keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

taro.notes: Native card sections/preset padding/content animations, interactive disabled cards, safe native navigation, statistics, icon actions/uncontrolled toggles and configured native tooltip integration. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Browser as/asChild and download/target/rel are not native navigation equivalents; tooltips use native tap/long press. angular.notes: Native Angular: MnChart. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

native.notes: Chart component of minerva-design/native: the canvas chart engine drawn with views (touch scrub, pinch zoom, legend toggles).

taro.notes: Cartesian charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free engine (minerva-design/charts presets): the web component props mapped to the same engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset, H5 mouse hover; ref exposes resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize. No WebGPU / WebGL renderer (one Canvas 2D path), no keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. QuadrantChart accessible points: a visually hidden list of the points (role / aria-role, aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap is onPointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons calling onPointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant. Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Mixed line/area/bar/scatter series on a <canvas type="2d"> (DOM-free canvas engine): axes, legend with tap-to-toggle, tooltip, crosshair, annotations, tap/scrub hover, pan when zoomed, pinch zoom, double-tap reset, point dragging, Minerva theme/palette/design tokens from the nearest provider. Properties are serialized by setData: data must be JSON (timestamps instead of Date, no typed arrays) and large data sets cost a copy per update. Function options (axis format, tooltip text) use configure(); tooltips are canvas text, not ReactNode content. No renderer choice, wheel or keyboard navigation. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

No WebGPU / WebGL renderer and no keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Browser indeterminate DOM property and native browser form serialization are not applicable. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Controlled/uncontrolled checked and indeterminate states, owner rejection, semantic colors, size, shape, label placement, custom icon, helper/error text and required state. Browser form serialization is not provided by native view-based choices. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Controlled/uncontrolled checked and indeterminate states, owner rejection, semantic colors, size, shape, label placement, custom icon, helper/error text and required state. name: ChordChart
description: Chord diagram of the flows between groups.

props.name: groups
props.description: Groups (names or `{ name, color }`), in their order around the circle; groups only named by `links` are appended. With `matrix`, unnamed rows are numbered from 1.

props.name: matrix
props.description: Square flow matrix: `matrix[i][j]` flows from group `i` to group `j` (used when `links` is absent)

props.name: links
props.description: Flows as a list (by group name or index); takes precedence over `matrix`

props.name: directed
props.description: `false`: one ribbon per pair of groups, as wide as the flows between them in both directions (a symmetric matrix counts each relation once). `true`: one ribbon per direction, arcs sized by the outgoing plus the incoming flows (self flows ignored)

props.name: arrows
props.description: Arrowheads at the target end of the ribbons

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between the groups, in degrees

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Angle of the first group, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock

props.name: sortGroups
props.description: Order of the groups around the circle

props.name: sortSubgroups
props.description: Order of the ribbon ends along an arc: `auto` minimizes the crossings; otherwise the order of the groups, or by value

props.name: ribbonColor
props.description: Color of the ribbons without `color`: a gradient from the source to the target color, one of the two, or a neutral gray

props.name: ribbonOpacity
props.description: Opacity of the ribbons, 0-1 (hovered ribbons are more opaque)

props.name: arcWidth
props.description: Thickness of the group arcs, in pixels

props.name: ticks
props.description: Value ticks outside the arcs (labelled where there is room); a number sets the step between ticks

props.name: tickFormat
props.description: Formats the tick labels

props.name: labels
props.description: Group labels along the arc (`tangential`) or the radius (`radial`); `auto` picks tangential when every name fits; colliding labels are shortened or skipped

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D, above the shapes

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French (English otherwise)

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back. Leave undefined to let the legend hide / show entries by itself.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

props.name: options
props.description: Other engine options (`ChordChartOptions`: renderer, padAngle, startAngle, sortGroups, sortSubgroups, ribbonOpacity, arcWidth, ticks, arrows, palette, format, percentFormat...); property only

events.name: minerva-hover
events.description: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, `null` when nothing is hovered

events.name: minerva-click
events.description: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }

events.name: minerva-toggle
events.description: A legend item was clicked (or `toggle()` called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

native.notes: Chart component of minerva-design/native: the canvas chart engine drawn with views (touch scrub, pinch zoom, legend toggles).

taro.notes: Shape charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free shape engine: legend toggles (controlled hidden), tap to highlight with the canvas tooltip, entry / update animations, sunburst drill-down with onDrill, and a generic ShapeChart taking any shape type's options. No keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Chord diagram: group arcs and ribbons from a matrix or links, directed flows with arrows, sorting, ribbon colors, value ticks (configure({ tickFormat })), legend toggles. Same as PieChart. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Shape chart drawn on a `<canvas type="2d">` by the DOM-free shape engine: group arcs and ribbons, legend toggles (controlled hidden), tap to highlight with the canvas tooltip, animations, hover/click/toggle events; ShapeChart takes the options of any shape type. No keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

name: CodeBlock
description: Read-only, scrollable code region with syntax highlighting and an optional copy button.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the scrollable code region (the native `aria-label` / `aria-labelledby` attributes also work)

props.name: wrap
props.description: Wraps long lines (pre-wrap) instead of scrolling horizontally

props.name: maxHeight
props.description: Maximum height before the block scrolls (numbers are pixels)

props.name: tabIndex
props.description: Tab order of the region; it is focusable by default so keyboard users can scroll it

props.name: copyable
props.description: Shows a copy button in the top-right corner that writes the text to the clipboard; its label switches to "Copied" / "Copy failed" for about two seconds and the result is announced through a polite live region. When set, the <pre> is wrapped in a <div> (see the interface description)

props.name: language
props.description: Language of the code: highlights its syntax and sets `class="language-<x>"` / `data-language` on the <code>. Supported: javascript (js, mjs, cjs), typescript (ts), jsx, tsx, json (jsonc, json5), css (scss, less), html (xml, svg, vue), bash (sh, shell, zsh, console), python (py), yaml (yml), sql, diff, markdown (md); other names render plain text. `"auto"` detects the language from the text (`detectCodeLanguage` of minerva-design/core, "plain" when unsure): the class, `data-language` and the label show the detected name. Without it the text is not highlighted

props.name: highlight
props.description: Highlights the syntax of `language` (false: plain text, the language is still set on the <code> and shown by `showLanguage`)

props.name: showLineNumbers
props.description: Numbers the lines in a gutter (hidden from assistive technology, not part of the copied or selected text)

props.name: showLanguage
props.description: Shows the `language` as a small label in the top-right corner (e.g. "JSON"); the <pre> is then wrapped in a <div> like with `copyable`

props.name: marks
props.description: Character ranges to mark (saved highlights, annotations, search hits), rendered as <mark> elements over the syntax highlighting (the token colors are kept; the copied text stays the raw code). `start` / `end` are UTF-16 offsets into the code string (`children`), clamped to it; empty ranges are ignored. Marks may cross tokens and lines (with `showLineNumbers` a mark is cut at each line break). Where marks overlap, the later one in the array wins (its color, class, title and click); the earlier one is cut around it. Each element gets `data-mark-id` (the mark's `id`) and the mark's `className` / `title`; `color` is a theme color name (a translucent tint) or any CSS color (default: translucent yellow, `--code-block-mark-bg`). To create one from the user's selection, see `getCodeSelectionRange` of `minerva-design/core`

props.name: code
props.description: Source text (default: the element's text content)

props.name: noHighlight
props.description: Keeps the code plain (no syntax highlighting) despite `language` (the React library's `highlight={false}`)

props.name: noWrap
props.description: Scrolls long lines horizontally instead of wrapping them (the React library's `wrap={false}`)

props.name: clickableMarks
props.description: Gives the marks a click affordance (pointer cursor, hover underline): set it when listening to `minerva-mark-click`

events.name: minerva-copy
events.description: The copy button (or `copy()`) was used: `detail: { text, success }` (`text` is the copied text; React's `onCopied` is called with it on success).

events.name: minerva-mark-click
events.description: A mark was clicked (not at the end of a text selection drag): `detail: { mark, originalEvent }` (`mark` is the item of `marks`, the topmost where they overlap; React's `onMarkClick`).
events.typeText: ((mark: CodeMark, event: MouseEvent<HTMLElement, MouseEvent>) => void) | undefined

events.name: copied
events.description: Called with the copied text after the copy button wrote it to the clipboard (not on failure). The counterpart of the `minerva-copy` event of `<minerva-code-block>` (`detail.text`, with `detail.success`); named `onCopied` so it does not replace the native `onCopy` clipboard event handler, which still goes to the element

angular.notes: Native Angular: MnCodeBlock. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

taro.notes: Safe native navigation, description/list composition, text wrapping and syntax-highlighted code (nested Text, opt-in line numbers / language label, character-range marks with tap) with native clipboard copying. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Navigator routes must be valid host routes; browser external-link behavior and HTML prose selectors are not equivalent. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Verbatim selectable source with syntax highlighting (core highlightCode rendered as nested text, never markup; language="auto" detects it with detectCodeLanguage), opt-in line numbers and language label, character-range marks (nested text backgrounds, markclick event on tap), wrap/horizontal scrolling, maxHeight, opt-in native clipboard copy of the raw text with status/copied/error events. Native clipboard replaces document clipboard permissions; no DOM pre/ref/keyboard-scroll event objects. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Syntax highlighting (core highlightCode, nested text with code-token colors; language="auto" detects it with detectCodeLanguage), opt-in line numbers and language label, character-range marks (nested text backgrounds, mark-click on tap), wrapped/unwrapped text, bounded scrolling maxHeight, native clipboard copy of the raw text with callbacks and localized feedback with cleanup. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

name: CommandDialog
description: Searchable command palette in a modal, with a global shortcut.

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state; leave `undefined` for uncontrolled.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state while uncontrolled

props.name: items
props.description: Commands to search. Disabled items are never shown.

props.name: title
props.description: Title of the dialog; defaults to the localized "Command palette".

props.name: description
props.description: Accessible description of the palette; defaults to a localized hint.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder of the search input; defaults to a localized hint.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches; defaults to the localized "No matching results".

props.name: shortcutLabel
props.description: Shortcut hint rendered as `<kbd>` next to the title, e.g. "⌘K".

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Global keyboard shortcut(s) that open the palette, e.g. "mod+k" (Cmd+K on macOS, Ctrl+K elsewhere). Modifiers: mod, ctrl, meta/cmd, shift, alt/option.

props.name: maxResults
props.description: Maximum number of results shown

props.name: filter
props.description: Custom search, e.g. to rank results by match quality. Receives the enabled items and the trimmed query (never empty) and returns the matching items in display order (then capped at `maxResults`). By default, items whose group, title, description or keywords contain the query (case-insensitive) are kept in `items` order.

props.name: resultsLabel
props.description: Accessible label of the results list; defaults to the localized "Command results".

props.name: enterLabel
props.description: Key hint shown at the end of the search input; defaults to the localized "Enter".

props.name: label
props.description: Title of the dialog (default: localized "Command palette")

events.name: minerva-select
events.description: A command was chosen (`detail: { value, item }`, `value` = the item's `id`); the palette then closes

events.name: minerva-open-change
events.description: The user asked to open (shortcut) / close (`detail: { open, reason }`); cancelable: `preventDefault()` keeps the current state

events.name: minerva-after-open
events.description: The palette is open and focus moved to the search input

events.name: minerva-after-close
events.description: The palette finished closing (after its exit animation)

angular.notes: Native Angular: MnCommandDialog. Native standalone component/directive; see platform tests for validated scope.

taro.notes: React title/keywords/description/group command data, native search, caller-preserved filter ordering, limits, reopening query reset, custom labels/hints and disabled-command exclusion in a modal. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports shared-core global shortcuts and active-option keyboard navigation; native touch/confirm interactions do not expose document shortcuts. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Controlled/default native dialog, trigger, trimmed command search, disabled exclusion, configured custom filter/ranking before cap, selection/close and localized labels. Global desktop shortcut/focus trap uses application-owned native navigation; native devices have no document keyboard listener. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Controlled/default open, normalized/custom filtering, disabled exclusion, grouping and result caps, original-item selection, keyboard navigation and platform shortcut normalization, query reset and opener focus return. Global browser keyboard shortcuts use document listeners; native hardware callers can use exposed handleShortcut. Native hosts do not expose DOM inert/focus-trap semantics. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

name: ConfigProvider
description: Theme / palette / design / locale scope (ConfigProvider for Web Components).

props.name: theme
props.description: Theme to apply: "auto" (follows `prefers-color-scheme`), a built-in theme name, a theme object, or a `{ light, dark }` pair. The root provider applies it to `<html>`; a nested provider inherits its parent's theme unless set, and applies an override to its own subtree only.

props.name: palette
props.description: Palette applied with the light / dark / system themes ("editorial", "tech", "graphite", "cool"); `null` keeps Minerva's default look. The root provider sets `data-palette` on `<html>`; a nested provider inherits its parent's palette unless set, and scopes an override to its subtree. Palette tokens come from `style.css`.

props.name: primaryColor
props.description: Brand color: sets `--primary-color` and recomputes every token derived from it (hover, active, subtle, border and text roles, selected, focus ring, and the accent when the palette has no accent of its own) with the default theme's formulas, without changing the light / dark mode. A single color applies to light mode and gets a dark-mode value lightened for contrast on dark surfaces (WCAG 4.5:1); pass `{ light, dark }` to choose both. Wins over the primary color of the theme and of the palette. Accepts hex, `rgb()` / `rgba()` and the basic named colors; an invalid value is ignored (development warning). A nested provider inherits its parent's brand color unless set (`null` restores the theme's own), and scopes an override to its subtree.

props.name: persist
props.description: Persist theme and palette changes in the `theme` / `palette` cookies and restore them after hydration (pair with `THEME_INIT_SCRIPT` for SSR). Root provider only: ignored by nested providers.

props.name: locale
props.description: Language of the React library's built-in texts. The root provider sets it globally; a nested provider inherits its parent's language unless set, and applies an override to its subtree only.

props.name: preset
props.description: Design preset: a named combination of the design axes below and a default palette. "minerva" (default look), "editorial" (restrained, reading-oriented: editorial palette, comfortable density, small radius, subtle shadows, large type), "compact" (dense, data-heavy screens) or "touch" (consumer mobile apps: comfortable density, 44px touch targets, large radius). Explicit axes and `palette` win over the preset. A nested provider inherits its parent's design unless set; a nested preset resets every axis it does not set.

props.name: density
props.description: Spacing density of controls (heights, paddings) and rows (menus, lists, tables): `data-density`

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius scale (`--radius-sm` ... `--radius-2xl`): `data-radius`

props.name: shadow
props.description: Elevation shadows (`--shadow-sm` ... `--shadow-xl`): `data-shadow`. "standard" keeps the theme / palette shadows

props.name: fontScale
props.description: Type scale (`--font-size-*`, line heights): `data-font-scale`. "large" is reading-oriented

props.name: design
props.description: Design preset (its palette applies unless `palette` is set)

props.name: root
props.description: Apply to the whole document (`<html>`) instead of this subtree

events.name: minerva-theme-change
events.description: The resolved light / dark mode changed (`detail: { mode }`), e.g. the system preference with `theme="system"`

events.name: palette-change
events.description: Called after `setPalette` changes the palette

angular.notes: Native Angular: MnConfig (mn-config): nested theme, palette, locale and design scopes.

native.notes: MinervaProvider (alias ConfigProvider): theme light / dark / system via useColorScheme, palette, design preset (touch by default), locale, safe-area insets

taro.notes: Native theme token classes plus resolved custom objects/light-dark pairs/github-dark, system subscription, theme/palette storage, nested inheritance, design axes and localized toggles/actions from shared dictionaries. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Browser cookies/SSR bootstrap use native storage instead. Provider-scoped dictionaries cover controls/editors, calendar/weekdays, command defaults, page-tab actions, display actions and application navigation; global native confirm outside a provider requires explicit localized labels. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Native ancestor relations inherit mode/theme/palette/design/locale/dir and react to parent updates; explicit null palette clears inheritance. Core translator/custom messages, localized Table/calendar/pagination/time/theme/sidebar texts, subscription/getConfig/translate APIs, system theme and GitHub/custom/bilingual token resolution. Native scoped views replace DOM root attributes. Other component label props can be supplied with provider.translate; their remaining hard-coded convenience defaults are not all localized. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Reactive nested locale/dir, inherited mode/palette/design, shared core catalog across editable/navigation/overlay/display controls, system appearance, isolated CSS tokens. Native view scoping replaces browser root attributes. Consumer slot content remains consumer-localized. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

taro.notes: Board of status columns in a horizontal ScrollView (scrollX): equal-width columns (columnWidth), fill when they fit, gap, height/maxHeight with vertically scrolling column bodies, translated region label; columns with an accent dot (theme color or CSS color), title, count badge announced with the title, description, actions, role=list cards wrapped in listitems, translated or custom empty content and a footer. draggable boards move DashboardCard children of keyed columns (value) with a long press and drag: columns and cards measured with createSelectorQuery (DOM rects on H5), drop line, highlighted target column, floating copy, canDrop, onCardMove. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Drag and drop is touch only (no keyboard or screen-reader moves): offer your own move actions (menus, buttons) for accessibility. No auto-scroll near the edges: the board stops scrolling while a card is picked up, and the page may still scroll on hosts that cannot cancel touchmove. Cards are measured once when picked up. No scroll snapping on native hosts. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. taro.notes: Controlled/uncontrolled disclosure, compound triggers/close/sections, accessible title/description, cancellable outside taps, modal backdrop choice, forceMount state, four drawer sides/sizes, five modal widths, reactive compound header naming and themed overlay surfaces. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Browser focus return/trap, scroll lock and inert background handling are not native equivalents. Non-modal drawers leave the page interactive; native page-global outside-focus/pointer listeners are unavailable, so non-modal dismissal uses the trigger/close controls. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Native composition uses Drawer: trigger slot requests controlled or default open. No standalone placeholder component is exported. Native serialized props, slots and parent-owned events replace DOM compound child context. Use Drawer props/slots for the native equivalent.

uni.notes: Shared controlled/uncontrolled open and modal context; native trigger registration for focus recovery. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

taro.notes: Two-sided study card: front/back/footer nodes, translated front/back captions and optional hint, controlled/uncontrolled flipped with onFlippedChange, flipOnClick, disabled, y/x axis, elevated/outline/filled variants, three sizes and minHeight. Both faces share one CSS grid cell (the card fits the taller face); the hidden face is aria-hidden and the back is a polite live region. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Mini-program hosts flip on tap only (no keyboard) and ignore prefers-reduced-motion; the CSS 3D rotateY/rotateX flip and backface-visibility need the WebView renderer (Skyline does not support CSS grid or 3D transforms). On H5 the card is a toggle button with Enter/Space and taps on interactive face content do not flip it. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Two-sided study card: front/back/footer named slots with plain-text front/back properties, translated front/back captions and optional hint, controlled (flipped, null = uncontrolled) or defaultFlipped state with flippedchange, flipOnClick, disabled, y/x axis, elevated/outline/filled variants, three sizes and minHeight. Both faces share one CSS grid cell (the card fits the taller face); the hidden face is aria-hidden and the back is a polite live region. Tap to flip only: no keyboard toggling and no prefers-reduced-motion crossfade in mini programs. The CSS 3D rotateY/rotateX flip, backface-visibility and the grid stack need the WebView renderer (Skyline does not support CSS grid or 3D transforms). Taps on interactive slotted content also flip the card (no DOM event path). The footer wrapper is always rendered (slot content cannot be detected). Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

name: FunnelChart
description: Funnel of the stages of a process, with conversion rates.

props.name: data
props.description: Stages: a name, a value and an optional color

props.name: sort
props.description: Order of the stages

props.name: gap
props.description: Vertical gap between the stages, in pixels

props.name: conversion
props.description: Shows the conversion rate from the previous stage

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the stages: trapezoids that narrow to the next stage, or centered bars

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D, above the shapes

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French (English otherwise)

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back. Leave undefined to let the legend hide / show entries by itself.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

props.name: hideConversion
props.description: Hides the conversion rates from the previous stage

props.name: options
props.description: Other engine options (`FunnelChartOptions`: renderer, gap, palette, legend, format...); property only

events.name: minerva-hover
events.description: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, `null` when nothing is hovered

events.name: minerva-click
events.description: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }

events.name: minerva-toggle
events.description: A legend item was clicked (or `toggle()` called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

props.name: animation

props.name: deep

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: conversion
props.description: Shows the conversion rate from the previous stage (default `true`)

props.name: sort
props.description: Order of the stages (default `none`: the data order)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the stages: trapezoids narrowing to the next stage, or centered bars (default `trapezoid`)

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: gap

taro.notes: Cartesian charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free engine (minerva-design/charts presets): the web component props mapped to the same engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset, H5 mouse hover; ref exposes resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize. taro.notes: Native view layouts, token-aware Box background/radius/shadow and numeric size resolution, spacing and attached controls, container-measured responsive grids/SplitLayout, sections/actions, compact/expanded/floating AppShell navigation and mobile drawer with route-change dismissal. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. CSS as/asChild polymorphism is not native. Floating AppShell expands by touch rather than hover. Measurements initially use window width until the native selector query returns. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

taro.notes: Cartesian charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free engine (minerva-design/charts presets): the web component props mapped to the same engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset, H5 mouse hover; ref exposes resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize. No WebGPU / WebGL renderer (one Canvas 2D path), no keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. QuadrantChart accessible points: a visually hidden list of the points (role / aria-role, aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap is onPointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons calling onPointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant. Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Grid of cells colored by value from `data` cells (categories or numbers on both axes), colorScale / valueRange / radius; format() through configure(). Same as Chart. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

taro.notes: Native card sections/preset padding/content animations, interactive disabled cards, safe native navigation, statistics, icon actions/uncontrolled toggles and configured native tooltip integration. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Browser as/asChild and download/target/rel are not native navigation equivalents; tooltips use native tap/long press. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

taro.notes: Tag deduplication, literal multi-character separator input with retained tail, configurable blur/confirm commits, deduplicated filtered suggestions/create/removal/clear, native checkbox-group form serialization of committed tags, stable key/value rows and id-keyed field errors. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Native text-input events process pasted separators; browser clipboard selection offsets and combobox keyboard navigation are not exposed. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Controlled entries arrays/defaultEntries, legacy value object normalization, stable ids across edits, id-keyed key/value errors, add/edit/remove, readonly and rejected owner updates. Validation including duplicate keys belongs to the consumer, matching React; provide errors keyed by row id. Native events expose both detail.entries and the legacy detail.value rows. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: entries/defaultEntries and stable id-based edits/removal/errors; duplicate keys allowed and validation remains consumer-owned; multiline whitespace-preserving textareas, labels, unique addition ids, controlled rejection including native field rollback, model updates and inherited locking. Legacy value arrays remain accepted. Browser DOM refs and focus-to-remove-button behavior have no native equivalent; newly added rows focus their key textarea. Native textarea geometry and keyboard require device validation. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

native.notes: Core React Native has no media element. minerva-design/native exports MediaControls, the themed control bar driven by props (playing, currentTime, duration, onPlayPause, onSeek...), to wrap the player of expo-video / expo-audio (or react-native-video).

taro.notes: Video through the host <video> component (controls off, driven by createVideoContext: play/pause/seek/playbackRate/requestFullScreen) and audio through Taro.createInnerAudioContext, under a themed control bar: play/pause, skip back/forward (skipSeconds), touch seek bar with the buffered range and aria-valuetext, m:ss / h:mm:ss time, mute, audio volume bar, playback-rate cycle button, video fullscreen, loading spinner and translated error state; startTime (video initial-time, audio startTime), autoPlay, loop, muted/defaultMuted, title, poster, height/aspectRatio; onTimeUpdate/onEnded/onPlay/onPause/onLoadedMetadata/onError/onRateChange/onVolumeChange and a ref with play/pause/seek/context. controls={false} shows the host video's own controls. Captions: tracks (WebVTT or SRT, data: URLs inline) fetched with Taro.request, parsed by the shared minerva-design/core parser and drawn as an overlay synchronized with the time updates, a CC button with an Off / per-track choice row, the choice remembered in storage (default track otherwise) and onTrackChange. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Beta: needs device validation (WeChat / Alipay / H5 media behavior differs). The host video has no volume API (mute only, no volume bar); no picture-in-picture, no buffered range for audio on hosts that do not report InnerAudioContext.buffered, no keyboard shortcuts; icons are text glyphs (mini programs have no inline SVG). Captions follow the host time updates (about 4 per second), are not shown in the host's native fullscreen, ignore cue positioning / styling, and remote caption files need the app's request domain allowlist. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Video through the host <video> (controls off, driven by wx.createVideoContext: play/pause/seek/playbackRate/requestFullScreen) and audio through wx.createInnerAudioContext, under a themed control bar: play/pause, skip back/forward (skipSeconds), touch seek bar with the buffered range and aria-valuetext, m:ss / h:mm:ss time, mute, audio volume bar, playback-rate cycle button, video fullscreen, loading spinner and translated error state; startTime (video initial-time, audio startTime), autoPlay, loop, muted/defaultMuted, title, poster, height/aspectRatio; timeupdate/ended/play/pause/loadedmetadata/error/ratechange/volumechange events and play()/pause()/seek(seconds) instance methods. controls=false shows the host video's own controls. Captions: tracks (WebVTT or SRT, data: URLs inline) fetched with wx.request, parsed by the shared minerva-design/core parser and drawn as an overlay synchronized with the time updates, a CC button with an Off / per-track choice row, the choice remembered in storage (default track otherwise), a trackchange event and chooseTrack(index). Beta: needs device validation. The host video has no volume API (mute only, no volume bar); no picture-in-picture and no keyboard shortcuts; icons are text glyphs (no inline SVG in WXML). Captions follow the host time updates (about 4 per second), are not shown in the host's native fullscreen, ignore cue positioning / styling, and remote caption files need the app's request domain allowlist. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. taro.notes: Action/checkbox/radio/group/submenu entries, controlled open, size, measured side/alignment with viewport collision handling, disabled or cancelled triggers and close-on-select; context long press. Recursive submenus use separately measured fixed panels, directional arrows, RTL side preference, collision flipping and measurement cleanup. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports menu loops, typeahead, submenu arrows and document-wide nonmodal outside dismissal. Native context-menu opening uses long press and explicit dir; browser pointer coordinates and global document listeners do not apply on devices. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

Device-runtime validation is still required. Browser focus return/trap, scroll lock and inert background handling are not native equivalents. Non-modal drawers leave the page interactive; native page-global outside-focus/pointer listeners are unavailable, so non-modal dismissal uses the trigger/close controls. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

taro.notes: Monday-first 42-day grid, month navigation/rollover, date selection with spillover-month navigation, ordered highlighted ranges, three cell sizes, event counts/list/activation and custom event-region labels. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports roving arrows and Home/End day focus; native hosts use touch day selection. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Shared core local-date arithmetic; six-week Monday-first grid with configurable week start, controlled/default month and day, disabled dates/bounds, display-only range highlight, event counts/list/actions, today navigation and configured date labels. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Shared local-date core: Monday-first 42-day grid; controlled Date month and string selection/defaults; adjacent day navigation, today/year keys, localized headers and labels, event counts/clicks, display-only normalized ranges, size and day/event slots. Uni extensions: weekStartsOn, min/max and disabledDates. Keyboard metadata and native touch actions are implemented; device focus/geometry still require validation. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

taro.notes: Page-tab onSelect/actions/close events, measured overflow arrows and active-item native scrollIntoView; step selection, active-path tree expansion with explicit collapse persistence and renderLink(item,content,state). Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Native horizontal scrolling and touch activation replace browser keyboard navigation. Native route links require the application renderer or onItemSelect to navigate. PageTabs uses native scroll measurement and explicit dir for RTL; React has no reorder API, and child order follows the caller. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: React sections/id and legacy items/value schemas, active ancestor expansion, controlled/default expanded ids, collapsed/wrapped labels, descriptions/icons, query and configured filtering, guarded item selection and native page navigation. Use native page URLs for href. React router renderLink is represented by native selection events and slots; DOM link rendering is not supported. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Section and item data, active ancestor expansion, controlled/default expandedIds, collapse intent, filtering, item/link scoped slots, disabled guards and native route navigation. External navigation uses consumer link slots/platform routing configuration. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

taro.notes: Page-tab onSelect/actions/close events, measured overflow arrows and active-item native scrollIntoView; step selection, active-path tree expansion with explicit collapse persistence and renderLink(item,content,state). Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Native horizontal scrolling and touch activation replace browser keyboard navigation. Native route links require the application renderer or onItemSelect to navigate. PageTabs uses native scroll measurement and explicit dir for RTL; React has no reorder API, and child order follows the caller. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: React sections/id and legacy items/value schemas, active ancestor expansion, controlled/default expanded ids, collapsed/wrapped labels, descriptions/icons, query and configured filtering, guarded item selection and native page navigation. Use native page URLs for href. React router renderLink is represented by native selection events and slots; DOM link rendering is not supported. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

name: OrderBook

props.name: book
props.description: Book to draw, applied when the object changes (stream updates through the ref)

props.description: Sides shown: asks above the spread row and bids below, or one side

props.description: Rows whose size reaches this value are highlighted (walls)

props.name: downColor

props.description: `red-up` swaps the default colors (red bids and buys, green asks and sells), the convention of mainland China, Japan and Korea

name: OrderBookHeatmap
description: GPU liquidity heatmap of an order book over time.

props.name: book
props.description: Book, applied when the object changes (stream updates through the ref)

props.name: trades
props.description: Trades; when the array grows, only the appended ones are added

props.name: tickSize
props.description: Height of a price row (levels are aggregated into rows); a round multiple of the book's tick of about 0.1 basis point when omitted

props.name: interval
props.description: Time between two columns, in ms: the book is sampled at this pace

props.name: window
props.description: Visible time span, in ms (zoomable)

props.name: history
props.description: History kept, in ms (columns older than this are dropped)

props.name: depth
props.description: Price rows sampled on each side of the book per column

props.name: priceSpan
props.description: Visible price span (top − bottom); fits the best bid / ask of the window when omitted

props.name: colorScale
props.description: Scale from sizes to colors: `sqrt` keeps typical levels dim and lets significant liquidity glow, `linear` shows only the walls, `log` reveals thin liquidity next to them

props.name: sizeUnit
props.description: Unit of the sizes, shown after them in the legend and the tooltip (e.g. "BTC"); the numbers are not converted

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend of the color ramp (cold to hot, its size range) and of the trades, in the top-left corner of the plot

props.name: contrast
props.description: Multiplies the sizes before the scale: above 1 brightens thin liquidity (more of the field glows), below 1 keeps only the largest walls

props.name: maxSize

This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

taro.notes: Native anchored composition/close, controlled opening and outside dismissal; measured side flipping/viewport shifting/width matching; tooltip offsets, alignment, visual variants/animations, composed triggers, callbacks and provider timing. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Browser hover/cursor following and portal positioning are not native equivalents; tooltip delay groups apply to native tap/long-press opening and closing. Geometry is measured on opening/resizing and at 100 ms intervals while visible, with cleanup on close/unmount. Native clipping ancestors and glass backdrop filtering require device validation. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Controlled/default tap popup; trigger/anchor/content slots, native selectorQuery placement, four sides/alignment/offsets, collision flip/shift, width matching, arrows, forceMount, modal backdrop, configured outside veto and reposition(). Native view/backdrop replaces DOM portal, focus trap and browser focus/pointer event objects; owner-triggered content/scroll changes can call reposition(). Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Controlled/default compound state; separate trigger/anchor native measurement; side/align/offset, viewport flip/shift/size, matchAnchorWidth, arrow, forceMount; cancelable dismiss/focus callbacks; resize/native polling cleanup. H5 supports body Teleport, composed asChild triggers/anchors/close actions, modal focus trap, inert background and scroll locking. Native panels use fixed host geometry; native views cannot reproduce browser child cloning or document focus semantics. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

native.notes: Chart component of minerva-design/native: the canvas chart engine drawn with views (touch scrub, pinch zoom, legend toggles).

taro.notes: Cartesian charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free engine (minerva-design/charts presets): the web component props mapped to the same engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset, H5 mouse hover; ref exposes resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize. No WebGPU / WebGL renderer (one Canvas 2D path), no keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. QuadrantChart accessible points: a visually hidden list of the points (role / aria-role, aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap is onPointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons calling onPointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant. Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Quadrant matrix with the web props (points, domains, splits, quadrants with badge/description, axis labels, showTicks, reverseX, labels, pointSize, showCounts, selectedIndex/selectedIndices rings); pointclick, quadrantclick and pointdrag/pointdrop events. quadrantContent (ReactNode overlays) has no canvas equivalent: place host views with the layout event and toPixel(). renderQuadrantHeader and getPointProps are React-only; showCounts takes no formatting function. Accessible points (accessiblePoints): a visually hidden list of the points (aria-role / aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap emits pointclick) with 'Move to …' buttons emitting pointdrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant (when draggable). Mini-program views take no keyboard focus and have no live region: no focus ring, no Shift + arrow moves, and the move is not announced. Dragging is enabled by the draggable property (a native host cannot detect a bound pointdrop handler). Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Cartesian chart drawn on a `<canvas type="2d">` by the DOM-free engine: the web component props mapped to the same presets and engine options, tap / scrub tooltip, legend toggles, pinch zoom, pan and double-tap reset; hover/pointClick/plotClick/zoom events and a template ref handle (resetZoom/getView/setView/getInstance/resize). No WebGPU / WebGL renderer and no keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Quadrant badges, descriptions, showCounts (boolean only) and the selectedIndex/selectedIndices rings are drawn; renderQuadrantHeader and getPointProps are React-only. Accessible points (accessiblePoints): a visually hidden list of the points (aria-role / aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap emits pointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons emitting pointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant (with a pointDrop listener). Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.
