native.notes: On the native QuadrantChart (views, no SVG): add button in each quadrant header, edit / delete toolbar next to the selected (tapped) task, an inline panel anchored in the board (at the + button or the task) with a name field and a 2 x 2 quadrant radio grid, and an inline confirmation before a delete (a press outside or Android back closes it); moves by dragging a dot or the screen-reader "Move to" actions. No double tap to edit (use the toolbar)

taro.notes: Controlled task board on top of the Taro QuadrantChart (points in, onPointsChange out; every other QuadrantChart prop is forwarded, its chart `labels` excepted): a row of quadrant headers under the chart (badge, quadrant title, count unless showCounts={false}, plus-icon add button), an actions toolbar for the selected task (task name, Edit and Delete text buttons; selection is internal or the controlled selectedIndex), an inline panel opened under the headers or the actions toolbar (a caret points at its opener) with a required name Input (the keyboard confirm key saves) and a 2 x 2 quadrant radio grid with Cancel / Save (Save disabled until the name is not blank), an inline danger confirmation before a delete, tapping an empty quadrant area to add a task there, drag and drop of the dots and the chart's accessible "move to" actions. Add/edit/move/delete/selection logic and the localized texts (labels overrides) come from the shared minerva-design/charts quadrant task helpers. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Beta: needs device validation. No keyboard moves (Shift + arrow keys) or double-tap to edit: mini-program views take no focus and the chart has no double tap; use the Edit button and the move to actions. The actions toolbar sits under the chart instead of floating on the selected dot, and the quadrant headers are a row under the chart instead of over the quadrants. The add buttons draw the plus icon as an SVG data URI image; Edit and Delete are text buttons. Input aria-label and the accessible point list are read on H5; native hosts expose aria-role/aria-label only where the host supports them. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: quadrant-task-board: controlled task board composing the native quadrant-chart, button and icon-button components (usingComponents in its JSON). points in, pointschange { points } out; every quadrant-chart property is forwarded except the chart's own labels (labels are the board texts, partial overrides of the localized defaults). A 2 x 2 grid of quadrant headers above the chart (badge, title, count unless showCounts is false, plus-icon add button), a toolbar for the selected task (name, Edit and Delete buttons; selection is internal or the controlled selectedIndex), an inline panel opened under the headers or the actions toolbar (a caret points at its opener) with a name input (the keyboard confirm key saves) and a 2 x 2 quadrant radio grid with Cancel / Save (Save disabled while the name is blank), an inline danger confirmation before a delete, tapping an empty quadrant area adds a task there, and draggable dots (default true) or the chart's accessible Move to buttons move a task. Add/edit/move/delete/selection logic and texts come from the shared minerva-design/charts quadrant task helpers. Chart methods (configure, resize, resetZoom, getView, setView, getPlotRect, toPixel, fromPixel) are forwarded to the inner chart; pointclick, pointdrag, hover, zoom and layout are re-emitted. Beta: needs device validation. The canvas has no view overlays: the quadrant headers are a grid above the chart (the chart still draws its own quadrant titles) and the actions toolbar sits under the chart instead of floating on the selected dot. No double-tap to edit and no keyboard moves (Shift + arrow keys): mini-program views take no focus; use the Edit button and the Move to actions. The add buttons draw the plus icon as an SVG data URI image; Edit and Delete keep text glyphs (✎, ✕). Layout styles are inline (no dedicated stylesheet yet). The inner components are in the board's shadow tree: the config-provider / theme-provider relation across that boundary (theme tokens and messages of the inline panel) needs device validation; the board's locale is forwarded to the chart explicitly. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

taro.notes: Controlled task board on top of the Taro QuadrantChart (points in, onPointsChange out; every other QuadrantChart prop is forwarded, its chart `labels` excepted): a row of quadrant headers under the chart (badge, quadrant title, count unless showCounts={false}, plus-icon add button), an actions toolbar for the selected task (task name, Edit and Delete text buttons; selection is internal or the controlled selectedIndex), an inline panel opened under the headers or the actions toolbar (a caret points at its opener) with a required name Input (the keyboard confirm key saves) and a 2 x 2 quadrant radio grid with Cancel / Save (Save disabled until the name is not blank), an inline danger confirmation before a delete, tapping an empty quadrant area to add a task there, drag and drop of the dots and the chart's accessible "move to" actions. Add/edit/move/delete/selection logic and the localized texts (labels overrides) come from the shared minerva-design/charts quadrant task helpers. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Beta: needs device validation. No keyboard moves (Shift + arrow keys) or double-tap to edit: mini-program views take no focus and the chart has no double tap; use the Edit button and the move to actions. The actions toolbar sits under the chart instead of floating on the selected dot, and the quadrant headers are a row under the chart instead of over the quadrants. The add buttons draw the plus icon as an SVG data URI image; Edit and Delete are text buttons. Input aria-label and the accessible point list are read on H5; native hosts expose aria-role/aria-label only where the host supports them. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: quadrant-task-board: controlled task board composing the native quadrant-chart, button and icon-button components (usingComponents in its JSON). points in, pointschange { points } out; every quadrant-chart property is forwarded except the chart's own labels (labels are the board texts, partial overrides of the localized defaults). A 2 x 2 grid of quadrant headers above the chart (badge, title, count unless showCounts is false, plus-icon add button), a toolbar for the selected task (name, Edit and Delete buttons; selection is internal or the controlled selectedIndex), an inline panel opened under the headers or the actions toolbar (a caret points at its opener) with a name input (the keyboard confirm key saves) and a 2 x 2 quadrant radio grid with Cancel / Save (Save disabled while the name is blank), an inline danger confirmation before a delete, tapping an empty quadrant area adds a task there, and draggable dots (default true) or the chart's accessible Move to buttons move a task. Add/edit/move/delete/selection logic and texts come from the shared minerva-design/charts quadrant task helpers. Chart methods (configure, resize, resetZoom, getView, setView, getPlotRect, toPixel, fromPixel) are forwarded to the inner chart; pointclick, pointdrag, hover, zoom and layout are re-emitted. Beta: needs device validation. The canvas has no view overlays: the quadrant headers are a grid above the chart (the chart still draws its own quadrant titles) and the actions toolbar sits under the chart instead of floating on the selected dot. No double-tap to edit and no keyboard moves (Shift + arrow keys): mini-program views take no focus; use the Edit button and the Move to actions. The add buttons draw the plus icon as an SVG data URI image; Edit and Delete keep text glyphs (✎, ✕). Layout styles are inline (no dedicated stylesheet yet). The inner components are in the board's shadow tree: the config-provider / theme-provider relation across that boundary (theme tokens and messages of the inline panel) needs device validation; the board's locale is forwarded to the chart explicitly. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

No keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Sankey diagram: nodes in columns and links with thickness proportional to the flow, alignment, link colors / opacity, labels. Same as PieChart. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Shape chart drawn on a `<canvas type="2d">` by the DOM-free shape engine: legend toggles (controlled hidden), tap to highlight with the canvas tooltip, animations, hover/click/toggle events; ShapeChart takes the options of any shape type. No keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

name: Scatter3DChart
description: GPU 3D point clouds with an orbit camera.

props.name: series
props.description: Point clouds (objects, `[x, y, z]` tuples or typed-array columns)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: xAxis
props.description: X axis (width of the box)

props.name: yAxis
props.description: Y axis (depth of the box)

props.name: zAxis
props.description: Z axis (height of the box)

props.name: camera
props.description: Initial camera, also restored by a double click (changing it moves the camera)

props.name: autoRotate
props.description: Turns the camera around the box: `true` at 12°/s or a speed in degrees per second; pauses while hovered, off-screen and with reduced motion

props.name: aspect
props.description: Proportions of the box (x, y, z)

props.name: box
props.description: Draws the axis box: back walls, grid lines, tick labels and axis titles

props.name: colorScale
props.description: Colors of `colorBy: "z"` / `"value"`: a built-in ramp or CSS colors

props.name: valueRange
props.description: Values mapped to the ends of the color scale; the data range by default

props.name: colorBar
props.description: Color bar; shown by default when a visible series uses the color scale

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; shown by default when several series have a name

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: interaction
props.description: Drag rotates, right / Shift + drag pans, Ctrl / ⌘ + wheel and pinch zoom, double click resets, arrow keys rotate; `false` makes the chart static

props.name: lighting
props.description: Lighting of the surfaces and bars

props.name: exposure
props.description: Brightness of the light of `blend: "additive"` series, tone mapped on WebGPU and WebGL2 (dense glowing regions saturate instead of turning white)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the data layer: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software

props.name: palette
props.description: Series colors (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: locale
props.description: Language of the built-in texts (accessible summary, legend announcements, tooltip row names) and of the number formatting; built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

props.name: options
props.description: Other engine options (`Chart3DOptions`: xAxis, yAxis, zAxis, camera, autoRotate, colorScale, colorBar, legend, tooltip, lighting, exposure, locale...); property only

events.name: minerva-hover
events.description: The hovered point, cell or bar changed; detail: { seriesIndex, seriesName, type, index, x, y, z, value, color, label }, `null` when nothing is hovered

events.name: minerva-point-click
events.description: A point, cell or bar was clicked; detail: { seriesIndex, seriesName, type, index, x, y, z, value, color, label }

events.name: minerva-camera-change
events.description: The user rotated, zoomed, panned or reset the camera; detail: { azimuth, elevation, zoom, pan, projection }

events.name: minerva-renderer-change
events.description: The backend is ready (or fell back after a GPU loss); detail: { renderer }

taro.notes: Single-choice segmented switch from string/object options (icon, label, disabled, aria-label), controlled/uncontrolled value, three sizes, neutral/primary thumb, fullWidth, disabled and an equal-width sliding thumb. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports roving arrows (left-to-right only) and Home/End selection; native hosts use touch selection. Segments always share the width equally. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

Icons are text only and there is no form field integration. DOM roving keyboard focus is not a native mini-program interaction. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. props.name: value
props.description: Value (controlled): a number, or `[start, end]` with `range`. Values are clamped to min..max and snapped to the step (or to the marks)

props.description: Snaps the value to the closest mark (instead of the step)

props.description: Disables the slider. Inherited from an enclosing FormControl when not set; an explicit `false` overrides the FormControl

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable and submitted, but the user cannot change the value. Inherited from an enclosing FormControl when not set

props.description: Formats a value for the value label, the tooltip and aria-valuetext

props.description: Direction of the track

props.description: Extra id(s) of elements describing the slider, merged with the enclosing FormControl's helper / error text

native.notes: Touch slider on the responder system (press the track, drag; the gesture is not stolen by a parent ScrollView), one or two thumbs, marks, value label and drag tooltip; each thumb is adjustable (increment / decrement). Horizontal or vertical (orientation; the vertical track runs bottom = min to top = max, 160 dp by default); no hidden form input (use FormField / onChangeEnd).

taro.notes: Custom touch slider (not the host slider) with one or two non-crossing thumbs, min/max/step or marks-only snapping, step or labelled marks, controlled/uncontrolled value, onChange while dragging and onChangeEnd on release, five colors, three sizes, value label, drag tooltip, hidden named inputs and FormControl disabled/readOnly/invalid. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. The track is measured with createSelectorQuery on touch start (cached afterwards; a layout change is picked up on the next touch). Horizontal sliders are left-to-right only; orientation vertical runs the track bottom (min) to top (max). H5 supports arrow/PageUp/PageDown/Home/End keys on the focusable thumbs; native hosts use touch only and expose no adjustable accessibility actions. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Custom touch slider (not the host slider) with one or two non-crossing thumbs, min/max/step or marks-only snapping, step or labelled marks, controlled/default value with change { value } while dragging and changeend { value } on release, five colors, three sizes, value label, drag tooltip, formatValue/getAriaValueText through configure(), hidden named inputs and form context disabled/readOnly/invalid. The track is measured with createSelectorQuery on touch start (cached afterwards). Horizontal sliders are left-to-right only; orientation vertical runs the track bottom (min) to top (max). There is no keyboard or adjustable screen-reader gesture on native views (stepThumb(key, index) steps programmatically). A range submits two inputs with the same name, which native forms collapse to one value. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

name: SunburstChart
description: Sunburst of a hierarchy, with drill-down.

props.name: data
props.description: Nodes: leaves carry a value, parents sum their children

props.name: innerRadius
props.description: Radius of the center circle as a fraction of the outer radius

props.name: levels
props.description: Rings shown at once below the focused node (fewer when they would be thinner than 18 px)

props.name: startAngle
props.description: Angle of the first node, degrees clockwise from 12 o'clock

props.name: padAngle
props.description: Gap between the sectors, in pixels

props.name: cornerRadius
props.description: Corner radius of the sectors, in pixels

props.name: labels
props.description: Sector labels: `auto` writes each name along the arc or along the radius, whichever fits best; labels that do not fit are shortened or skipped

props.name: drill
props.description: Clicking (or Enter on) a parent zooms into it; clicking the center (or Backspace) goes back up

props.name: drillPath
props.description: Names from the root to the focused node (`[]` = the root). Makes the drill-down controlled: clicks then only call `onDrill`, whose `path` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D, above the shapes

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage, series, node, bar, row or level

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the chart writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, number and percent formats, calendar dates); built-in texts in English, Chinese, Japanese and French (English otherwise)

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap or sunburst nodes / sankey nodes / radial bars / bullet rows / calendar levels, by index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only call `onToggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back. Leave undefined to let the legend hide / show entries by itself.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations (skipped when the user prefers reduced motion)

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart

props.name: renderTooltip
props.description: React content of the tooltip (replaces the default content)

props.name: noDrill
props.description: Disables the drill-down (clicking a parent zooms into it by default)

props.name: options
props.description: Other engine options (`SunburstChartOptions`: renderer, levels, startAngle, padAngle, palette, format...); property only

events.name: minerva-drill
events.description: A parent or the center was clicked (or `drill()` called); detail: { path }

events.name: minerva-hover
events.description: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, `null` when nothing is hovered

events.name: minerva-click
events.description: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }

events.name: minerva-toggle
events.description: A legend item was clicked (or `toggle()` called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. Browser validation/autocomplete differ. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

props.name: variant

props.description: Density of the cells

props.name: scroll
props.description: Horizontal minimum width / vertical maximum height of the scroll area. props.description: Highlights body rows on hover

events.name: sort-change

props.description: Dashed vertical lines where a day starts (intraday bars)

props.name: crosshair

props.name: legend

props.name: lastPriceLine

props.name: countdown
props.description: Time left until the current bar closes, under the last price label

props.name: highLowMarkers
props.description: Marks the highest and lowest prices of the visible bars

props.name: markers
props.description: Buy / sell markers

props.name: priceLines
props.description: Order, position, take profit / stop loss and alert lines

props.name: orderEntry
props.description: A "+" button at the crosshair price, on the right of the price pane: clicking it reports a limit order (`orderCreate`) at that price, a buy below the last price and a sell above it (with Alt / Option held: the stop order of the other side). With the chart focused, `B` / `S` arm a buy / sell order at the crosshair price (or the last price), the arrows move it (Shift: ten ticks), Enter confirms and Escape cancels. The order is a limit when it waits for a better price (a buy at or below the last price, a sell at or above it), else a stop; `Alt+B` / `Alt+S` switch between limit and stop explicitly. `O` selects the draggable lines in turn to move them the same way, Delete cancels the `cancellable` ones

props.name: volumeProfile
props.description: Volume by price of the visible bars, with its point of control and value area (`true` for the defaults)

props.name: compare
props.description: Comparison series (best read with `scaleMode: "percent"`)

props.name: drawings
props.description: Drawings; replaced when a new array is passed (see `drawingsChange`)

props.name: drawingMode
props.description: Active drawing tool

props.name: keepDrawingMode
props.description: Keeps the drawing tool after a drawing is made (back to `cursor` otherwise)

props.name: drawingToolbar

props.name: autoscaleIncludesDrawings
props.description: The automatic price scale also fits the visible drawings of each pane (lines, channels, position tools...)

props.name: baselinePrice
props.description: Price of the `baseline` style; the close of the first visible bar by default

props.name: rightOffset
props.description: Empty space after the last bar, in bars

props.name: barSpacing
props.description: Initial width of a bar, in pixels

props.name: wheel
props.description: Mouse wheel: `zoom`, `modifier` (zoom with Ctrl / ⌘ only, so the page scrolls) or `none`

props.name: kineticScroll
props.description: Keeps panning after a quick drag

props.name: grid
props.description: Grid lines

props.name: watermark
props.description: Large faint text behind the bars (`"BTCUSDT · 1H"`)

props.name: labels
props.description: Overrides of the built-in texts of the `locale`

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the bars and lines (WebGPU, then WebGL2, WebGL, Canvas2D)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible label; built from the symbol by default

props.name: options
props.description: Other engine options (`TradingChartOptions`: markers, priceLines, drawings, colorConvention, locale, timeZone, sessionBreaks, orderEntry, volumeProfile, autoscaleIncludesDrawings, labels...); property only

native.notes: Chart component of minerva-design/native: the canvas chart engine drawn with views (touch scrub, pinch zoom, legend toggles).

taro.notes: Shape charts drawn on a Canvas 2D node by the DOM-free shape engine: legend toggles (controlled hidden), tap to highlight with the canvas tooltip, entry / update animations, sunburst drill-down with onDrill, and a generic ShapeChart taking any shape type's options. No keyboard navigation and no React tooltip content: tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Treemap: nested nodes (squarified), parent headers, gap, path in the events. Same as PieChart. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Shape chart drawn on a `<canvas type="2d">` by the DOM-free shape engine: legend toggles (controlled hidden), tap to highlight with the canvas tooltip, animations, hover/click/toggle events; ShapeChart takes the options of any shape type. No keyboard navigation; tooltip.render may only return text. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

QuadrantChart accessible points: a visually hidden list of the points (role / aria-role, aria-label with name, quadrant and values; a tap is onPointClick) with 'Move to …' buttons calling onPointDrop with the center of the neighbouring quadrant. Mini-program views take no keyboard focus, so there is no focus ring nor Shift + arrow moves, and no live region: the move is announced (role=status) on H5 only. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

taro.notes: Seven-day strip with firstDayOfWeek, controlled/uncontrolled day and week, today ring, count badge/dot markers with translated day labels, previous/next week navigation and three sizes. Native touch/view semantics differ from browser DOM semantics. Native devices do not expose document focus, inert, browser portals or File input APIs; H5 capabilities are specified separately. Device-runtime validation is still required. H5 supports roving arrows and Home/End within the week (the navigation buttons change the week); native hosts use touch day selection. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official Taro WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

weapp.notes: Shared core local-date arithmetic; the seven days of a week from firstDayOfWeek with controlled/default YYYY-MM-DD selection and week (an uncontrolled week follows the selection), today override, count/dot markers with localized accessible names, getDayLabel through configure(), previous/next week navigation with a localized month heading, weekday labels, size, disabled and readOnly. Dates and the week are serialized YYYY-MM-DD strings. DOM roving keyboard focus is not a native mini-program interaction. Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

uni.notes: Shared local-date core: the seven days of a week from firstDayOfWeek; controlled/default string selection (v-model) and Date week (v-model:week, follows the selection while uncontrolled); today override, count/dot markers with localized accessible names, getDayLabel, previous/next week navigation with a localized month heading, weekday labels, size and disabled; listbox/option semantics with arrow, Home/End and PageUp/PageDown keys across weeks. Keyboard metadata and native touch actions are implemented; device focus/geometry still require validation. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.
